item.title: Session 1 — Hello Kannada!
item.description:
What We Covered

This week was all about making Kannada feel familiar and fun. We started with our welcome song which we’ll sing every week — it is already becoming a favourite!

Songs and Rhymes

  • Welcome song — we will sing this every week to open class
  • ಮಳೆ ಮಳೆ ಬಾ ಬಾ (Rain song) — great for actions and movement

New Vocabulary — Colors

Kannada Pronunciation English
ಕೆಂಪು kempu Red
ನೀಲಿ neeli Blue
ಹಳದಿ haladi Yellow
ಹಸಿರು hasiru Green
ಬಿಳಿ bili White

Story Time

We listened to a short story about a little elephant learning the colours of the jungle. Ask your child to tell you what colours the elephant saw!

item.title: Session 1 — New Structure, New Term
item.description:
What We Covered

This was a transition session introducing a new structure for the term. We also announced the year-end showcase and voted on our topic.

Showcase Vote Result

The class voted and chose Option 2 — A Day in a Kannadiga Family for our year-end performance. Congratulations to everyone for a great discussion about why this topic matters to them.

item.title: Teachers
item.description:
Our Teaching Team

ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡ ಶಾಲೆ is led by teachers and volunteers who care deeply about helping children build confidence, connection, and pride in Kannada.

Use this page to introduce:

  • Lead teachers
  • Classroom volunteers
  • Curriculum coordinators
  • Guest storytellers or cultural presenters

Teaching Approach

Our teachers use songs, stories, conversation, games, and structured practice. The goal is to make Kannada feel useful, joyful, and connected to family and community life.
